_comment: The LindDUP data set's pipeline configuration, v11 (2026-11-17; decisions D-104..D-109, D-112..D-114, D-138..D-151 and D-155 of docs/project/SBI_decisions_and_ideas_log.md on SBI main; 2026-11-18, D-155: S2's quiet window 1 h, was 6 h). LindDUP (D-104): the joint DSN+NPE stack trained on the LindaColloDUP15 campaign lcdup15_rho1300_neur_n01 (D-138: it replaces MEAMA completely; neurons only, 159 CAdEx cells, 180 s; trained as it is, D-139) and the DUP15HD recordings (DATA_C control and DATA_P DUP, the cohort of record extracted_v2). Three arms, each searched and fitted on the same banks (D-140, D-148 (1)): A1, A2 and A5, each with 148 cores (D-141). Every key is required; a key starting with '_' documents the key after it and is ignored. Values not yet read on the data are marked [to verify]: tools/inputs_check.py reads them on davinci before the first submission.
_paths: Where everything lives on davinci (absolute; no '~'). The two repositories are the checkouts Giulia uses; every LindDUP folder carries linddup (D-104).
_envs: As Giulia's: extraction and banks in sbi_export, training and search in sbi_env.
_real: S1 is done: the DUP15HD cohort of record, extracted_v2/cohort_manifest.json sha256 c925c5106137fe82 (35 wells: control 17 = DATA_C, pathological 18 = DATA_P; 9 subregions of 9 electrodes; 1200 s), so the driver skips S1 while the manifest matches its .sha256. The raw recordings moved to LindaColloDUP/recordings/ on 2026-11-17 (D-142; symlinks at the old paths); extracted_v2 did not move. cohort_map (v11, D-148 (4); Sbi-extractor block 9): the well map in this folder -- donor = the condition (D-144), pairing group = condition x batch (Batch3 / Batch4, D-146), and the five wells of DATA_P/Batch4 that are byte-identical copies of DATA_P/Batch3/SubBatch1's left out (D-145): 30 wells, 17 control and 13 DUP.
_sim: S2, the re-detection of lcdup15_rho1300_neur_n01 at the DUP15HD probe (n_side 3 and fs 10110.09 from the manifest, pitch 60 um D-021, edge 25 um D-024: the Sbi-extractor profile linddup.sh, overridden here). 815 tasks (163 cfd of 6,144 simulations, 652 cpu of 1,536; 442,473 simulations on 2026-11-17 [CLUSTER]); the arrays removed by the user, so no task is being written. Before S2, a topology folder without topology_meta.json must be moved out of its sweep folder: the virtual MEA stops on its whole task otherwise (the ANN reply of 2026-11-17, sec. 2.2). plan_args: S2's plan leaves out every task changed less than 1 h before it and plans again at each round (D-112; 1 h since 2026-11-18, D-155, was 6 h). Jobs on intel (D-141): 48 cores, 12 h per task [estimate: a cfd task re-detects 128 simulations per core], 9 at once under the cap.
_freeze: S3, the label freeze of lcdup15 (flat rule, conn_prob drawn per topology): theta = the 13 active axes of the neuron_synapse group (job_args _active_indices, read on the tasks, never hard-coded) then conn_prob, p = 14 (D-138). Nothing excluded: the 10 frozen axes of the group are not active.
_bank: S4-S6 (export_windows/, written into a profile by stages/bank.py). One campaign, one launch, so every task has the same boxes: the on-axis (the one axis whose box may differ across tasks, D-074) is gbarA with its own box [0.01, 10] nS, ln coordinate, so the declared box equals the sampled one [to verify: the inputs check reads the tasks' boxes]. topology_axes: conn_prob only (no contact gate in lcdup15). t_win_s 180: one window per simulation (D-041). n_e 9: the 3 x 3 probe of DUP15HD. The floor (D-075) keeps a window whose mean rate is at least 0.1 Hz. drop_partial_topologies (v11, D-143, D-148 (5); Sbi-extractor block 10): a topology with fewer simulations than its task dispatched (192 cfd, 48 cpu) is dropped whole. A simulated donor is one topology (D-076: one id per (task seeds, topology)), so the split keeps a topology's sibling runs together. Jobs on intel.

bank._verify: Giulia's (D-094): the verification job after every round's gate, 8 cores, 16gb, 2 h.
bank._max_rerun_rounds: Giulia's (D-094/D-095): a bad or missing task is moved to <banks_root>/linddup_sim_quarantine/ and the array runs again, at most twice.

_split: Giulia's (D-088): train / selection / report = 85 / 10 / 5 % of the donors (one donor = one topology of 192 or 48 simulations, D-076).
_searches: The three arms (D-140, D-148 (1); block 29), each its own search and best fit on the same banks, in this order, each capped at 148 cores (D-141: 3 jobs of 48 at once): A1 (S-A1: encoder and flow on the simulations alone), A2 (S-A2-only: the DSN term on the recordings' condition labels always on) and A5 (S-A5-only: the replicate term always on). Their term weights are searched as now, log10 lambda in [-3, 1], ranked on the simulated report NLL (D-149). Folders: <tune_root>/<name>/<campaign>, <runs_root>/<name>/linddup_best. Stop a search by hand with `pipeline.py stop-search --search <name>` (block 30): its best fit then starts on the best trial so far.
_replicate: The A5 pair rule (D-146, D-147, D-148 (3); block 31): two different real windows drawn at random among the windows of one pairing group, within-well pairs allowed; the group is the real bank's rep_group (the cohort map's condition x batch).
_search: Each arm's GP search, Giulia's design (D-141, D-088, D-086): 50 initial points, then 20 GP rounds of 10, 250 trials; no clock cap (D-150): a search ends after its 250 trials or when the user stops it.

search._shape_anchors: p and d_theta: the bank's theta width, 14 (13 axes and conn_prob); embedding_dim 64 anchors the flow-width rule as for Giulia.
search._space_overrides: Giulia's (F-s, D-086): depth_exponent [3, 5], embedding_size [16, 64], head_pool_ops [0, 1] (as in synth v4, the override frees the term-only campaigns' pin of head_pool_ops).
search._max_concurrent_trials: Giulia's 25; each arm's 148 cores hold 3 trials of 48 at once (block 29's per-search cap).
search._seeds: Giulia's (D-114): gp_seed 1, train_seed 0 (one donor split for every trial of every arm).
search._trial: Giulia's (D-088): 6 passes in 20 epochs, a whole 48-core intel node, 160gb, 120 h (intel allows 240 h); the budget gate measures the costliest configuration before round 0.
search._max_total_walltime_h: null: no clock cap (D-150); the user stops a search by hand (block 30).

_best_fit: S8 per arm, Giulia's (D-089): the finalist fitted as an ensemble of 10 members on one shared split (seed 1), 40 passes in 40 epochs, patience 10; 240 h, intel's limit (a member resumes from its checkpoint after a kill, D-111).
_loader: Giulia's (D-084): a buffer of 4 shards of 10,000 rows (about 0.7 GB of 18,000-sample windows per shard).
_driver: The sequencer as a chain of PBS jobs pl_linddup (D-098), 4 cores, 16gb, 24 h each, on intel.
_resources: D-141: 148 cores per arm, 444 for the project; the stages' jobs share 440 beside the sequencer's 4 (S2 runs 9 tasks of 48 at once, each arm 3 jobs of 48).
